## Design checklist

- [ ] Colours, type, space and radii come from tokens only.
- [ ] Each page has one primary action.
- [ ] No rows of equal cards.
- [ ] Motion is used only for state changes.
- [ ] Imagery is real, with alt text.
- [ ] Each route sets its title, description and Open Graph image.
- [ ] For UI work, `pnpm e2e` passes.

## Content checklist

- [ ] Copy is within the budgets in CONTENT.md.
- [ ] Headings and buttons are specific.
- [ ] No hedges.
- [ ] No lists of three written for rhythm.
- [ ] Each new sentence passes the specificity test.
